body.name: padded orthonormal relation construction
body.construction: Compute \(Q_c=I_{|S_c|}-\Pi_2(V_c)\), choose any \(B_c\) with \(B_cB_c^{\prime}=I\) and \(B_c^{\prime}B_c=Q_c\), and stack \(\overline R(P)=\operatorname{stack}_{c=1}^C\sqrt{p_c}B_cJ_c\); its Gram matrix is \(A(P)=\sum_cp_cJ_c^{\prime}Q_cJ_c\).
